entries.target: 减少受到的所有伤害 %d 点。

entries.source: @playerdescriptor.race@, you have helped me kill the Elf-wench. The Orc Pride thanks you... for now
entries.target: @playerdescriptor.race@，你帮我干掉了那个精灵臭婊子。兽人部落感谢你……暂时如此。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: +20 mindpower, +2 life regen, -1 equilibrium per turn, -20% resistance penetration.
entries.target: 地图效果 : +20 精神强度 , +2 生命恢复 , -1 失衡值 / 回合，-20% 抗性穿透。

entries.source: This ugly orc looks really nasty and vicious. He is obviously looking for something and bears an unknown symbol on his shield.
entries.target: 这只丑陋的兽人看起来凶恶而狠毒。他显然在寻找什么东西，盾牌上带着一个未知的徽记。

entries.source:
Some clues:

1) #LIGHT_GREEN#Defense#WHITE# is 20 and #LIGHT_GREEN#Physical Save#WHITE# is 21, yet they have different colors and positions.

2) There seems to be no overlap in positions. The 21 is entirely to the right of that 20, for example.

3) Each display scale is ten characters long, and each score takes up two characters.
entries.target:
一些线索：

1）#LIGHT_GREEN#闪避#WHITE#是 20，#LIGHT_GREEN#物理豁免#WHITE#是 21，但二者的颜色和位置不同。

2）它们的位置似乎完全不重叠。例如，21 完全位于 20 的右侧。

3）每条显示刻度长 10 个字符，每项属性值占 2 个字符。

entries.source:
When you crit you have a %d%% chance to reduce by 1 the remaining cooldown of one of your inscriptions and of any saturations effects.
		This effect can only happen once per turn.
entries.target:
每次暴击时有 %d%% 几率减少随机一个刻印 1 回合冷却时间，并减少符文紊乱或纹身紊乱 1 回合持续时间。
		该效果每回合最多触发一次。

entries.source:
Tune yourself into the ebb and flow of spacetime.  When your Paradox crosses a 100 point threshold, your Cosmic Cycle gains or loses one radius.
		While Cosmic Cycle is expanding, your temporal resistance penetration will be increased by %d%%.  While it's contracting, your Willpower for Paradox calculations will be increased by %d%%.
entries.target:
调谐自身，以适应时空的涨落。每当紊乱值跨过一个 100 点阈值，你的宇宙圈半径便增加或减少 1 格。
		宇宙圈膨胀时，你的时空抗性穿透提高 %d%%；收缩时，用于计算紊乱值的意志提高 %d%%。

entries.source: You stride into this area without a second thought, while stifling a yawn. You feel your time might be better spent elsewhere.
entries.target: 你大步流星地走进这片区域，打了个哈欠，你感到待在这里可能是浪费时间，最好到别的地方去看看。

entries.source: You somehow got teleported to an other Sher'Tul Fortress, in a very alien location. There you saw a living Sher'Tul.
entries.target: 不管怎样，你传送到了另一个异次元的夏·图尔要塞。在那里，你看到了一位活着的夏·图尔人。

entries.source: Increases physical save, spell save, and mental save by %d. Global speed increased by %d%%.
entries.target: 增加物理、法术、精神豁免 %d 点，增加全局速度 %d%%。

entries.source:
With some advanced preparation, you learn to create and equip a third tool (at #YELLOW#level %d#WHITE#):

%s
Preparing a tool sets its talent level and puts it on cooldown.
Only one tool of each type can be equipped at a time.
entries.target:
经过充分准备，你学会制造并装备第三件工具（#YELLOW#等级 %d#WHITE#）：

%s
准备工具会将其技能等级设为本技能等级，并使其进入冷却。
每种类型同时只能装备一件工具。

entries.source:
Enter a fluid, mobile shooting stance that excels at close combat. Your ranged attack speed is increased by %d%% and each time you shoot you gain %d%% increased movement speed for 2 turns.
Ranged attacks against targets will also grant you up to %d%% of a turn. This is 100%% effective against targets within 3 tiles, and decreases by 20%% for each tile beyond that (to 0%% at 8 tiles). This cannot occur more than once per turn.
Requires a sling to use.
entries.target:
进入流畅而灵活的射击姿势，更适用于近战。你的远程攻击速度增加 %d%%，每次射击令你在两回合内移动速度增加 %d%%。
命中敌人的远程攻击将给你带来 %d%% 额外回合，该效果对三格以内的目标有 100%% 效果，每增加 1 格距离，效果降低 20%%（8 格降为 0 %%）。该效果每回合只能生效一次。
该技能需要投石索。

entries.source: I will see if I can find him.

Sends a tremor through the ground which causes jagged rocks to erupt in a beam of length 5, dealing %d Physical damage (equal to your Strength, up to 150) and causing targets hit to bleed for an additional 50 damage over 5 turns. Bleeding can stack.
entries.target: 使大地震颤裂开，露出尖石，在5码直线上造成%d物理伤害（与你的力量值相等，最高150），并使击中的目标流血，在5回合内额外造成50伤害。流血伤害可以叠加。
#LIGHT_BLUE# 你强化了对 %s 的准备。

entries.source:
As you enter the familiar Fortress you notice a small orange cat has followed you somehow.
It looks like the kitty you fed earlier.
entries.target:
当你进入熟悉的堡垒时，你发现一只橙色的小猫不知怎么跟着你进来了。
它看起来就像你不久前喂过的那一只。

entries.source: You are asleep and unable to move!
Up to 3 times per turn when one of your glyphs triggers you feel a surge of celestial power, increasing your darkness and light resistance and affinity by 5%% for %d turns, stacking up to %d times.
entries.target: 当你的圣印触发时，天空能量的涌动让你获得暗影、光系抗性和伤害亲和各 5%%，持续 %d 回合，最多叠加 %d 次。该效果每回合最多触发 3 次。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s has spawned a dream projection to protect its mind!
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s产生了一个梦境投影来保护自己的心智！

entries.source: When attacking in melee, deals 15 light damage and lights tiles in radius 1.
entries.target: 近战攻击时，在1码半径内造成15光系伤害并照亮区域。

entries.source:
#{bold}#Tract of Destruction#{normal}#

Though armies would fall before the Spellblaze's might, though forests were razed and the skies bled red with fire, they always felt that the earth would endure. It seemed eternal, unmoving. Not even the fury of the Spellblaze could hope to destroy it.

How wrong they were. The Nalorën people, long secluded, were prepared to fend off any attacks on their land, but how could they hope to stop the land itself crumbling? Seeing their home literally tearing itself apart, plains and forests tumbling into the seas... For one brief, terrible moment, they beheld the true extent of the Spellblaze's power. Not only was it destroying the people of the world, but the world itself.

The lands of the Nalorën had sunk beneath the waves.
entries.target:
#{bold}#毁灭之源#{normal}#

尽管在魔法大爆炸强大的力量面前，军队眨眼覆灭，森林片刻消失，天空满是流火，但他们总认为大陆会安然无恙。它看起来永恒不变。甚至狂怒的魔法大爆炸都无法摧毁它。

但他们错了。这些与世隔绝了很久的纳鲁精灵，以为他们的土地可以抵抗任何的攻击，但他们怎能指望陆地去阻止它自身的崩溃？当看到房屋倒塌，海啸来袭——这一刻，他们才真正见识了魔法大爆炸的力量。它不仅毁灭了世上的人，也毁灭了这个世界。

纳鲁大陆缓缓沉入海底。

entries.source: Explore the Dungeon of Adventurer Enlightenment to learn about ToME's combat mechanics.
entries.target: 探索冒险者启蒙地下城，学习 ToME 的战斗机制。
#RED#展示 %s 套装给 %s 看（装备未切换）

entries.source: An old and powerful fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条年长且强大的火龙，拥有炽烈的火焰吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: You require a missile launcher and ammo for this talent.
entries.target: 你需要一件远程武器（弓、投石索等）和弹药才能使用这一技能。

entries.source: A blade-edged ring that radiates power. As you put it on, strange thoughts of pain and destruction come to your mind.
entries.target: 散发能量、边缘开刃的戒指。当你戴上它时，陌生的痛苦念头和毁灭的情景涌入你脑海。

entries.source: Got to level 20 of the infinite dungeon.
You are a female of the species.
Left mouse to show known talents
#ORCHID#Target out of range.  Hold <ctrl> to force all weapons to fire at targets out of ranges (%d - %d).
entries.target: #ORCHID#目标超出范围。按住<ctrl>来强制所有武器射击超出范围(%d-%d)的目标。

entries.source: The Pride chooses its allies. It has no master! ATTACK!
entries.target: 部落自己选择盟友。部落没有主人！攻击！

entries.source: You have not finished your romantic time at the beach.
entries.target: 你还没享受完在海滩的浪漫时光。

entries.source: Unlocked Archmage class and did over one million cold damage (with any item/talent/class).
entries.target: 解锁大法师职业并造成累计100万冰冷伤害（使用任意物品/技能/职业）。
格尔格勒克·黑暗吞噬者

entries.target: 猎人与猎物　第二章
